title: Space / Four service films
provenance: Original authored geometry, typography, PBR materials, studio lights and periodic camera / product animation. System Arial fonts rasterized into rendered frames; no font file distributed with public media.

render.purposeful_motion: Cotton card lifts and fans with a restrained product turntable
render.geometry: Original authored Blender meshes, text, curves and studio lighting
render.materials: PBR metal, leather, cotton, glass and ink; procedural micro roughness

identity.mobile_layout: Full uncropped Full HD 1920x1080 rendition at 60fps; CRF24, 6M maximum rate, 12M buffer, no padding or subject cropping.
identity.loop: 2-second periodic authored motion. Frames1–120 at60fps exported in chronological order; pose121 equals pose1.
identity.validation: Every video fully decoded; dimensions, average/nominal FPS, frame count, duration, pixel format, no audio and faststart checked.
identity.source_raster_cleanup: Deleted only this production’s intermediate PNG frames after master and all three public renditions passed full decode and hash verification. Blend, master, previews and per-frame hashes retained.
